crossRefs.note: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel…

translations.web: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.
translations.bsb: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
translations.kjv: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
translations.asv: As therefore the tares are gathered up and burned with fire; so shall it be in the end of the world.
